Wright Investors Service Has Raised Its Facebook (FB) Position; 7 Bullish Analysts Covering Lancashire Holdings Limited (LON:LRE)
June 17, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Wright Investors Service Inc increased Facebook Inc (FB) stake by 18.24% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Wright Investors Service Inc acquired 5,169 shares as Facebook Inc (FB)’s stock declined 0.01%. The Wright Investors Service Inc holds 33,509 shares with $5.35M value, up from 28,340 last quarter. Facebook Inc now has $566.91 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.49% or $0.96 during the last trading session, reaching $195.85. About 21.86 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
